playwright.notes: The endpoint is registered as 'localhost', not '127.0.0.1': @playwright/mcp enforces a Host check and answers 403 to a 127.0.0.1 Host header. The socket still binds 127.0.0.1 only. 'isolated' is required, not cosmetic - without it a second concurrent client is refused outright.

gateway.reason: mcp-gway was evaluated and deferred. Episodic Memory cannot be fronted without renaming its tools, and Claude Code speaks HTTP to the shared Playwright directly, so a gateway would add a process and a hop for nothing. Reinstate it when a second shareable stdio backend appears - and do NOT default to 8080, which Docker Desktop holds on some machines.

episodicMemory.reason: BLOCKED. Its agent and skills hardcode the mcp__plugin_episodic-memory_* tool names, so any re-exposure under another name breaks them silently. The SQLite index is already shared; only the process count is duplicated.

superpowersChrome.reason: Must NOT be shared: it drives a live Chrome over CDP, so two clients would fight over the same tab. Per-session, or disabled and enabled on demand.
